declaration.preface: Bedmutha Industries Ltd remains committed to ensuring fair, equitable, and competitive compensation for all employees, regardless of gender, role, or geographic location.
declaration.declaration:
The Living Wage Policy reflects our dedication to fostering an inclusive and fair workplace by addressing wage disparities and promoting equal opportunities across our organization.

This policy includes a firm commitment to paying a living wage to all employees, with clear targets, public transparency, and mechanisms to ensure sustained adherence to living wage standards.

At Bedmutha Industries Ltd, we are committed to fostering a workplace that values fairness, inclusion, and transparency in compensation practices. This commitment ensures all employees receive equitable pay for their contributions, aligned with our values and ethical standards.

Our policy prioritizes living wages, competitive salary structures, and unbiased compensation systems that reflect employee skills, experience, and responsibilities. This includes proactive measures to address pay gaps, periodic wage reviews, and alignment with global standards for fair compensation.

We set quantitative targets, develop robust systems, and allocate the necessary resources to ensure consistent adherence to this policy. Through collaboration, innovation, and transparency, Bedmutha Industries extends its commitment to Living wage across the entire organizational and operational framework.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
Conducting regular wage assessments to ensure all employees are paid at or above the living wage threshold, reflecting local economic conditions and industry benchmarks.

By 2026, Bedmutha Industries Ltd will ensure that 100% of its workforce is paid above the living wage benchmark for their respective locations.

A continuous commitment to maintaining living wage compliance will be enforced, with yearly reviews to adjust benchmarks in line with inflation, cost of living, and market changes.

This policy establishes 2022 as the baseline year for measuring progress and achievements in Living Wage initiatives.

The Living Wage Policy applies to all employees, contractors, and consultants of Bedmutha Industries Ltd across all operations, departments, and facilities.

Commitment to Living Wage: Bedmutha Industries Ltd remains committed to ensuring fair, equitable, and competitive compensation for all employees, regardless of gender, role, or geographic location.
The Living Wage Policy reflects our dedication to fostering an inclusive and fair workplace by addressing wage disparities and promoting equal opportunities across our organization.
This policy includes a firm commitment to paying a living wage to all employees, with clear targets, public transparency, and mechanisms to ensure sustained adherence to living wage standards.
Promoting Fair Compensation and Equity: At Bedmutha Industries Ltd, we are committed to fostering a workplace that values fairness, inclusion, and transparency in compensation practices.
Our policy prioritizes living wages, competitive salary structures, and unbiased compensation systems that reflect employee skills, experience, and responsibilities.
This includes proactive measures to address pay gaps, periodic wage reviews, and alignment with global standards for fair compensation.
Providing training programs for HR personnel and managers on fair compensation structures, living wage standards, and unbiased pay practices.
Establishing mechanisms for employees to raise concerns or grievances regarding wage disparities anonymously, ensuring confidentiality and non-retaliation.
Collaborating with unions and worker representatives to ensure fair wage practices and foster open dialogue about compensation-related concerns.
Equal Pay Initiatives: Bedmutha plans to achieve 100% compliance with industry standards for gender pay parity by 2026.
The company targets annual disclosure of pay equity audit findings to foster transparency and accountability.
Supplier and Partner Alignment: By 2026, all suppliers and contractors will comply with living wage principles, verified through independent audits.
Bedmutha aims to monitor and evaluate supplier adherence to living wage practices annually.
Internal and External Reporting Mechanis: Bedmutha provides confidential channels, including a Living Wage hotline and HR grievance portal, for employees to report wage-related concerns.
All complaints are reviewed by the HR Department and escalated to senior management if necessary.
The company publishes an annual Living Wage Report, outlining progress on living wages, pay audits, and corrective actions.
Bedmutha engages third-party auditors to validate its commitment to Living Wage and compliance with industry standards.
Governance and Accountability: The Board of Directors ensures the overall implementation of the Living Wage Policy, holding senior management accountable for achieving wage equity and living wage goals.
The HR Department conducts annual wage audits, oversees corrective actions for disparities, and ensures compliance with living wage standards.
The Compliance and Audit Team ensures adherence to Living Wage laws, verifies living wage adherence, and manages third-party audits for transparency.
Managers are responsible for ensuring fair pay within their teams and addressing wage-related concerns promptly.
Employees are encouraged to participate in Living Wage initiatives, report discrepancies, and engage in discussions about pay practices.
Suppliers and Contractors are required to comply with Bedmutha’s Living Wage principles and undergo periodic assessments to verify adherence.
